notes: Calls are fixed. Incoming calls now ring properly, and answering one actually connects instead of sitting on "Connecting". If a group call is already running you join it instead of starting a second one, and you can move a call between your phone and your computer with the green Join bar. The call screen now fits any screen size, with your own video as a small tile you can drag out of the way. Also fixes voice messages, file uploads and screen sharing in the browser.
